## Type of Documentation Issue

- [ ] **Content is outdated** - needs updating to match current functionality
- [ ] **Content is missing** - new documentation needed
- [ ] **Content is incorrect** - factual errors or broken examples
- [ ] **Content is unclear** - needs better explanation or examples
- [ ] **Broken links** - links that don't work or go to wrong place
- [ ] **Formatting issues** - display problems, broken components
- [ ] **Accessibility issue** - missing alt text, poor contrast, etc.

**Priority level:**
- [ ] **Critical** - Blocks users from completing important tasks
- [ ] **High** - Causes significant confusion or frustration
- [ ] **Medium** - Minor issue that should be addressed
- [ ] **Low** - Nice to have improvement

## User Impact

[Describe the user experience problem this causes]
